title: Bowling Kristianstad

title: Team Planner
description: A private absence list and team planning tool for bowling clubs.
longDescription: Team Planner is a web application built for bowling clubs that need a simple way for members to report when they cannot play, without requiring member accounts. Members access the club page through a private link or QR code, select their name, and mark unavailable play days. Admins can manage players and teams, view absence lists, sync matches from Swebowl, and use a TeamPlanner view to build lineups with player slots, reserves, coaches, and copyable team sheets. The project uses a PostgreSQL database and role-based admin access.

title: Interactive House
description: A multiplatform smart-home simulation for monitoring and controlling devices in an Arduino-based house model.
longDescription: Interactive House is a multiplatform smart-home simulation developed as part of the Software Engineering course at Kristianstad University. The system allows users to monitor and control devices such as lights and fans in an Arduino-based house model through web and mobile interfaces. My contribution was within the server group, where I worked on the central backend responsible for device registration, state management, command handling, authentication, and communication between user interfaces and connected devices.
features: Command handling between UI and devices
REST API for web and mobile clients

title: Solace
longDescription: Solace is a desktop application we developed during the Agile Development Methods course.
